verdict.rationale: Increase is an API-first bank. It publishes an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs, offers an official CLI, manages accounts programmatically, exposes a List Events API, and lets teams track payment lifecycles and account holds programmatically, so an agent can read much of the banking picture without scraping. However, the evidence never shows explicit transaction-listing or document-retrieval endpoints, and there is no MCP surface. Missing for 10: explicit read endpoints for transactions and pending transactions, document/statement access via API, an official MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration of agent read access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read the full banking picture — accounts, transactions, pending activity, documents — through a clean API or MCP surface without screen-scraping a dashboard

citations.quote: You can instantly create multiple Account Numbers for a single Account and manage them programmatically.
you can also request Events from the Increase API using the List Events API.
Holds reduce the available balance without moving money, and can be released when they're no longer needed.
allowing the team to programmatically track payments instead of needing to parse through a single, massive ledger.
